text.p: These are the leading stories in Zimbabwe's state-owned Herald newspaper on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- The Zimbabwe government will set up an indigenisation (black economic empowerment) agency through an Act of Parliament to monitor the economic progress of the southern African country, including compliance by multinational companies with a call to sell some shares to blacks.

- Transport and Energy Minister Simon Moyo has ordered Zimbabwe's Meteorological Services Department to resume giving rainfall figures to the Herald newspaper as they are of national importance. The department had barred the publication of the rainfall tables as a cost-cutting measure.
